title: S3 object storage
description: S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, MinIO, SeaweedFS, RustFS, ...). The connection carries endpoints. Consumers usually bring their own identity (an s3SecretRef parameter); secretRef is only set on stores declared by hand.

apiUrl.title: API endpoint
apiUrl.description: Leave the AWS regional endpoint out for AWS S3 itself; set it for MinIO, SeaweedFS and other S3-compatible servers.

internalUrl.title: Internal URL
internalUrl.description: In-cluster address, used by workloads instead of going out through the ingress.

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: Set when the store is declared by hand. A store published by a chart leaves it unset: its consumers name their own bucket.

accessKey.title: Access key ID
accessKey.description: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the accessKey key. An access key identifies a caller, it does not belong in a readable object.

secretKey.title: Secret access key
secretKey.description: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the secretKey key.

pathStyle.title: Path-style addressing
pathStyle.description: Required by most self-hosted S3 servers. AWS S3 uses virtual-host style.
